verdict.rationale: Skyfire says its tokens conform to the 'open KYAPay protocol, an industry specification' and claims broad acceptance across the commercial internet. That points toward an ecosystem posture. However, no independent party is named as implementing KYAPay, and charging, wallets and settlement all run through Skyfire's own APIs, so third-party sellers and card networks look like integrators of Skyfire's platform rather than independent implementers. Missing for 10: at least two named independent implementations of the protocol, third-party corroboration of adoption, and evidence of issuance or settlement outside Skyfire.
